title: Kayan aiki, tafiyar aiki da bayarwa: daga takaice zuwa yanke shawara a rubuce
course_title: Aiki mai nisa & Haɗin gwiwar Ƙungiya: Ƙungiyoyin Rarraba Masu Jagora

say: Kayan aiki, tafiyar aiki da bayarwa.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don module na biyu na Aiki Nesa da Haɗin gwiwar Ƙungiya.

Ƙungiyar da aka rarraba tana zaune a cikin kayan aikinta. Lokacin da fayiloli suka zauna akan kwamfyutocin sirri kuma ana binne yanke shawara a cikin taɗi na sirri, ƙungiyar ta shafe sa'o'i tana bincike da tambaya.

say: Har ila yau, aiki yana shiga cikin gibi, kamar mutane biyu kowanne yana tunanin ɗayan yana da wani aiki.

say: Abubuwan da aka raba suna riƙe bayanan sirri, don haka kare su. Kunna tabbacin mataki biyu don kowane asusun aiki.

panel.heading: Kare filin aiki da aka raba

cards.d: Kunna shi don kowane asusun aiki, gami da WhatsApp, imel da drive.
Raba bayanan sirri tare da mutane masu suna kawai. Cire hanyar barin barin rana guda.
Saƙonnin imel ɗin 'takardun da aka raba tare da ku' na karya suna satar kalmomin shiga. Bude tuƙi daga alamar alamar ku.

say: Ba da mafi ƙarancin damar da ake buƙata. Kar a raba fayiloli tare da bayanan sirri tare da kowa mai hanyar haɗin yanar gizo. Lokacin da wani ya fita, cire hanyarsu a rana guda.

say: Kowane aiki yana buƙatar mai shi mai suna. Don yanke shawara, tsarin DACI yana ba da matsayi huɗu.

panel.heading: Mai shi ɗaya, bayyanannen matsayin yanke shawara
items: Direba: yana samun yanke shawara akan lokaci
Amincewa: wanda ya yanke shawara
Masu ba da gudummawa: murya, ba kuri'a ba
Sanarwa: fada da zarar an yanke hukunci

say: Direba yana tattara bayanai kuma ya yanke shawara ta kwanan wata da aka amince. Mai Amincewa shi ne wanda ya yanke shawara.

say: Masu ba da gudummawa suna ba da shigarwar ƙwararru, murya amma ba ƙuri'a ba. Ana sanar da masu sanarwa da zarar an yanke shawara.
Sunan waɗannan ayyuka yana kawo ƙarshen yanke shawara da aka tattauna tsawon makonni kuma ba a yanke ba.

panel.heading: Mai shi ɗaya, bayyanannen matsayin yanke shawara
items: Direba: yana samun yanke shawara akan lokaci
Amincewa: wanda ya yanke shawara
Masu ba da gudummawa: murya, ba kuri'a ba
Sanarwa: fada da zarar an yanke hukunci

say: Kowace Juma'a Kemi tana aika sabuntawar matsayi a cikin sassa guda biyar: matsayi, aikata, na gaba, katange, da yanke shawara da ake bukata.
A wannan makon matsayinta yana cikin haɗari, saboda aikin zane na flyer ya yi kwanaki 3 a makare.
Shawarar ta na bukatar: ta buga foloers 5,000 akan kusan naira 45 kowanne, kimanin naira 225,000, ko kuma 3,000 akan naira 55 kowanne, kimanin naira 165,000.
Ta sanyawa Direba sunan, ita kuma Mai Amincewa, Bola. Ta ba da shawarar 3,000, saboda masu aikin sa kai 38 za su iya ba da kusan 80 kowanne.
Bola ya yarda a cikin sharhi, kuma Kemi ta rubuta hukuncin tare da kwanan wata da dalilin.
Kira na awa ɗaya tare da mutane takwas yana amfani da sa'o'i takwas na lokacin ƙungiya, da farashin bayanai. Don haka da farko tambaya: shin wannan zai iya zama takarda mai tsokaci?

panel.heading: Tarurukan da suke samun lokacinsu
items: Tambayi farko: wannan zai iya zama takarda?
Ajanda sa'o'i 24 kafin, tare da pre-karantawa
Matsayin suna: mai gudanarwa, mai ɗaukar rubutu
Karanta baya ayyuka tare da masu mallaka da kwanan wata
Buga taƙaitaccen bayani a cikin ranar aiki ɗaya

say: Idan kun hadu, sanya ajanda aƙalla awanni 24 kafin. Rubuta kowane abu azaman tambaya tare da sakamakon da kuke buƙata.

panel.rule: Ba a gama taron ba sai an buga taƙaitaccen bayanin.

say: Don tunawa. Ba kowane nau'in bayani gida ɗaya, da sunan fayilolin kwanan wata tukuna.
Ba kowane ɗawainiya mai shi ɗaya kuma kowane yanke shawara ɗaya Mai yarda.
Sanya sabuntawa na mako-mako a tsayayyen tsari. Alama aiki A cikin haɗari lokacin da kuke shakka kwanan wata. Kuma ku sanya kowane taro ya ƙare da taƙaitaccen taƙaitaccen bayani.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Gida ɗaya don kowane irin bayanai
Kwanan-farko sunayen fayil, hanyoyin haɗin kai ba haɗe-haɗe ba
Mai shi daya a kowane aiki; Mai Amincewa da kowane hukunci
Sabunta mako-mako: matsayi, yi, na gaba, katange, yanke shawara
Ajandar da ta gabata, rubutaccen taƙaitaccen bayani bayan

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Taswira da tsara filin aikin ƙungiyar ku, rubuta taƙaice tare da sabunta matsayi da shawarar DACI, kuma gudanar da taro ɗaya tare da ajanda da taƙaitaccen bayani.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Taswira kuma tsara filin aikin ku

Gudanar taro ɗaya daidai
